values.value: {!Email.ucinn_ascendv2__Organization_Name__c} invites donors to support future generations and be a participant in the advancement of society. {!Email.ucinn_ascendv2__Organization_Name__c} communicates with a positive, engaging, and confident voice. {!Email.ucinn_ascendv2__Organization_Name__c} wants to make it clear that donors are valued, and that contributions have an immediate and pertinent impact.
